snippet.title: Cards After Midnight - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
#steam 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4512690?utm_source=youtube&utm_campaign=announcement&utm_medium=youtube

A dark roguelike card adventure where a deadly curse controls the clock. Become a savage werewolf at midnight and a weapon-wielding survivor by day while escaping the villagers hunting you down.

You are the seventh son of the seventh son, born into a humble 19th-century farming family. When you reach adulthood, the truth of your bloodline finally reveals itself. Every night at midnight, you transform into a werewolf.

The villagers discover what you are… and now they want you dead. Forced to flee, you must travel across isolated villages, dark forests, abandoned churches and dangerous roads, searching for the truth behind your curse while surviving the relentless hunt. But time is never on your side.

Cards after Midnight is a dark roguelike card adventure combining strategy, survival and deckbuilding, where the passing of time changes how you play.

Features:
- Master Two Sides of the Curse: Transform into a brutal werewolf at midnight, then return to human form at dawn and adapt your strategy.
- Build Your Deck, Survive the Hunt: Build and adapt your deck with weapons, abilities, tools and powerful perks.
- The Clock Is Your Curse: As the hours pass, your abilities, threats and strategy change with the cycle of day and night.
- Unleash the Beast: Embrace your werewolf form to gain devastating abilities and unstoppable momentum.
- Explore a Dark 19th-Century World: Travel through isolated villages, dark forests, abandoned churches and dangerous roads in search of answers.

©2026 JanduSoft & Boomfire Games
